notes.title: BPM: Custom Music Update
notes.notes:
BPM's most requested feature is finally here: Custom Music.

We've been very busy working on the Nintendo Switch port of BPM, but now that's done we are finally able to bring this feature to BPM on PC.

You are now able to add music that you have created into BPM, and will be able to shoot, dodge and dash to the beat of your own soundtrack.

Here is a tutorial video that will show you how to get your music set up to work in BPM:
https://youtu.be/iRj82LgFN7o

Notes & Known Issues:

[list]
[*].MP3 files may cause syncing issues which could result in the music going out of time with the beat. Use .WAV to be safe.
[*]BPM will likely stutter (temporarily) a number of times throughout gameplay due to this update. This is completely temporary and because your GPU needs to recache shaders.
[*]Custom music can only be toggled on or off from the main menu.
[*]In Custom Music mode, pausing and unpausing the game will cause the music to restart.
[*]In Custom Music mode, your track's name and bpm will be displayed on the in-game TAB menu
[*]The game will recalibrate your BPM to be between 60 and 120 BPM. In our testing we think the game plays best with songs that are 70-90BPM.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Heiðrún head projectiles are now targetable. No unavoidable damage.
[*] Latency test results screen is now passable with Enter if your tests timed out. 
[*] Latency test added to game settings.
[*] UI scale setting is now configurable with mouse more easily. 
[*] Missing Chinese missing characters fixed.
[*] Photosensitivity screen now skippable after 1 second.
[*] Russian font support (Cyrillic font). Thanks to community member Sergio270.
[*] Russian translation improvements.
[*] Spanish translation improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Centered “reload” text.  X
[*] At UI scale 1.2x, stats going off the screen fixed
[*] Block Ability is now offset correctly
[*] Fixed Endless spinning on the main menu if your FPS is low
[*] UI scale changes now save to file
[*] Volume settings apply on game startup
[*] Fixed Library only producing Secondary Abilities
[*] There is now no green when transitioning between Helheim rooms
[*] Adjusted Vanaheim pitted room
[*] Fixes some particle game hitches (some hitches still remain)
[/list]

More fixes will be coming. 

If our upgrade in Engine isn't working for you consider rolling back on a beta branch to either "rollback_pre_translations" or "rollback_sept_23_2020".

notes.title: Localisation + Performance Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Localisation added for German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese - Simplified
[*] “The Crypt” track added to the Steam OST
[*] “Reload by Firing” Setting - When turned on, the firing your weapon button also acts as the reload button
[*] Photosensitivity Warning
[*] Performance Optimisations
[*] Lighting and graphics have been optimised to improve performance on low-end PCs
[*] Improvements to game stutters (some do remain)
[*] Improvements to autoaim on gamepad
[*] Improvements to loading times
[*] Latency Test added
This does NOT fix or calibrate any latency issues, but will reveal them if present. Extreme latency will make BPM unplayable in it’s intended way of playing. If detected, the game will turn on Auto-Rhythm mode. (99% of PC players will not have any issue with latency. The majority of latency issues will come from BPM being played on TVs with poor latency, and Bluetooth headphones/speakers)

Bug Fixes:
[*] Fixed bug in Vanaheim where enemy spawns directly in front of you
[*] Fixed double weapon glitch (Mengiyord)
[*] Fixed revolver pickup sound playing during loading screens
[*] Fixed Multiplier UI glitch
[*] Fixed glitch in Svartalfheim where an enemy can teleport behind the wall
[*] Removed Herobrine
[*] + many more
[/list]

This update has put us in a good place with lots of optimisations for consoles that we can build on in our future games. We aren't done with the BPM franchise folks!

notes.title: BPM: OVERDRIVE UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37636403/ca36f57ebd1c0a2d33353ef0db0034204ba69b5f.png[/img]

We’re happy to bring you the BPM: OVERDRIVE update. Since release, we’ve been working hard to bring more to BPM. In this update we have added five brand new characters that let you play BPM in a new unique way, three new weapons to encourage more killing of enemies to the beat, a brand new chapter with its own unique enemies, two new difficulties, and much more good stuff!

[previewyoutube=WoB3bEB8_q0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Key Features:[/b]

5 New Characters
3 New Weapons
1 New Chapter
2 New Difficulties: Hellish and Practice

[b]Additional Additions of Stuff:[/b]

New achievements
Over 20 new items
New abilities
New enemies
New unique room types
A new boss
Gameplay balancing
Trials (Items that make your runs more challenging)
Ultrawide FOV support
Per chapter hue slider (change colour of filter)
Optimisation
New challenges
Save game stability fixes
Crash fixes
Level fixes
Asgard has been tweaked
New rooms added
Raygun charge time shortened
Lighting changes
Little changes everywhere
New floor modifiers
Floor entry blur shorter
Windows darkened in Dark floor modifier
Some sounds tweaked
Gambling machine repurposed

We hope you’re excited to play! We’ve loved making this game, and with this update finished, we’re planning the future for games from Awe Interactive.

notes.title: Patch #1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for a great launch! We’re so happy to see people enjoying the unique experience that BPM offers. We’ve been working on a patch last week to fix some issues. This is not the end of our support for BPM but the beginning. 

[list]
[*] Feature – Added a 3rd wave challenge chest that holds the some of the best items in the game. 
[*] Feature – Added new weapon.
[*] Feature – Map goes to the middle of the screen when you press tab.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed – If you fall off a platform you can’t double jump. (ODR run killer)
[*] Fixed – Game restoring the player to bad locations after falling into pits.
[*] Fixed – A few unoptimised textures. (Minor improvement)
[*] Fixed – Duplicate skeleton keys and duplicate lucky dice appearing.
[*] Fixed – Mage enemy getting stuck in walls. 
[*] Fixed – Audio settings not loading on launch.
[*] Fixed – Toned down some screen flashes. More to be done here. 
[*] Fixed – Dragon’s Heart has been renamed “Dragon’s Skin” and the description modified to be less confusing.
[*] Fixed – “Asp's Whisper” combined with certain weapons completely stopping bosses moving.
[*] Fixed – Upped max FOV to 145 for ultrawidescreen users.
[*] Fixed – Raygun impact effect is off time. (Removed impact for raygun)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Tentatively Fixed – Music changing volume as you move.
[*] Tentatively Fixed – Stuck in room with closed doors.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Balance – On easy baby bats have a range limitation. 
[*] Balance – On easy baby bats have fire slower projectiles. 
[*] Balance – Default pistol range slightly buffed by 1.5m.
[*] Balance – Raygun is more rare.
[*] Balance – Cooldown reduction appears less. Appears in challenge chests. 
[*] Balance – Drop rates for items have been changed. 
[*] Balance – Less coins drop in later chapters. There was an over abundance of coins in later chapters.
[*] Balance – Some weighting towards filling all stat statues. 
[*] Balance – Nidhogg health quadrupled.
[*] Balance – Vanaheim onwards boss health increased.
[*] Balance – Dragon’s Skin has been made more rare and moved into the ‘Valkyrie’ pool.
[*] Balance – Dragon’s Skin has been nerfed to build shield at 50% of the previous rate. 
[*] Balance – Demon pools have been modified to favour good stuff. 
[*] Balance – Mechanised Monster does a similar effect to the shield enemies to better communicate that they can’t be damaged when locked down.
[*] Balance – Gauss cannon has been slightly nerfed, but it’s still heart-rendingly OP. 
[*] Balance – Gauss cannon is more often on the ‘expensive’ pedestal in the armoury.
[*] Balance – Heal ultimate is less powerful. 
[*] Balance – Other small fixes.
[/list]

You’ll have to start a new run to get some of these changes. 

We’ve been reading your comments. We’ll be focusing on doing the things that improve the game for everyone over the coming months. Going forwards we want to add more: difficulties, challenges, characters, items, modes and weapons.
